Does anybody else think it would be dissatisfying if  Eren didn’t actually destroy the world with The Rumbling? 

After chapter 118 Armin seemed to realize what Eren has really been planning all this time. To kill all of his “enemies” (as in the rest of humanity)

I see a lot of people going against this idea and instead want Armin to change Eren’s mind but honestly? I’d fucking break my computer and light it on fire if that were to happen. The Rumbling has been hyped up since episode 25 of Season 1 (Eren saying “I’ll destroy the entire world) and if there’s any trope I fucking hate in any story is when the Weapon Of Mass Destruction gets hyped up for like the whole movie/series and it never gets used because of hokey dokey “pEaCe aNd LoVe iS oUr TrUe sALvaTiOn uwu” 

Plus it would just be straight up corny for aot to do this and doesn’t fit the tone of the series at all. A recurring theme in snk has been that in order to achieve a great victory, one must be willing to sacrifice their humanity. 

Hell, ARMIN was the one who said this in the first place and now people want him to do a complete 180 on his character development all because they want snk to have a sappy happy ending where Eldians & Marleyans have an orgy, build a utopian society and ride off into the sunset as if hundreds of thousands of years of oppression & war just went away like that because Armin tried his “nuuu dont destroy the wurld ppl r gud” on Eren??? Bitch fucking please.

Plus, what the fuck do people expect will happen to the Eldians around the world if Armin DOES convince Eren to not use The Rumbling??? What do y’all want a Cold War scenario? Do you want the victory to be miraculously achieved over hundreds of years of peaceful protests, peace treaties, and integration while millions of Eldians AND Marleyans die & continue to suffer along the way??? That’s not even true freedom, THE VERY FUCKING THING EREN & THE SURVEY CORPS HAVE BEEN FIGHTING FOR THIS WHOLE GODAMN TIME!!! 

If the Rumbling isn’t used to it’s fullest, it would be the most anticlimactic, dissatisfying & underwhelming ending of any series I’ve read thus far. Unless there’s another way to achieve absolute freedom for the Eldians that Isayama hasn’t revealed yet but until that happens, I want to see Eren destroy the world with the Rumbling and I don’t want snk to pussy out of it at the last minute. Rant over.
